svg.title: Bar chart comparing average cost per WELLBY by evaluator. The Happier Lives Institute evaluations average $28, far cheaper than State of Life ($180), Krekel and colleagues ($308), and Pro Bono Economics ($2,361), reflecting the Happier Lives Institute's focus on LMIC interventions. Bar chart comparing average WELLBYs created per $1,000 donated by evaluator. The Happier Lives Institute evaluations average 35.79, more WELLBYs created per $1,000 donated than State of Life (5.56), Krekel and colleagues (3.25), and Pro Bono Economics (0.42), reflecting the Happier Lives Institute's focus on LMIC interventions.
